catalog_quirks.body: AMD Radeon Cloud's shared Model API is free and does not consume GPU-instance credits. Its public models are experimental and may rotate; per-account request and daily allowance values are reported dynamically in response headers rather than guaranteed as fixed catalog limits.
catalog_quirks.title: Free shared roster rotates
